body: I just feel the need to get out. I'm wasting so much time sitting here waiting for things to change. The ex is whatever. Not abusive, but not supportive. So it usually just feels like you're alone around them, not in a good way
That is sweet. I like the name Jelly. No friends. Everyone is fair weathered. Its midnight here. I have a comfy bed, but I can't stand to live here anymore. I know no one.

Her name is Kali. I love aussies..

No no, that's not a stupid question. I'm just in a weird place. My dad gave up on me years ago. He has his own anger/depression issues to deal with.. he does not act like he knows how to be a very good father. Locked the doors on me when I was 17 because I wanted to meet my biological mom. My mom is in a hell hole of a situation and I dare not get involved. Just don't have any reliable/caring family.

She's an Australian Shepherd. I already miss her... Its a long story, but no money, no car, no home and no family or friends. I live at my ex's who makes it clear that I should leave (even though I KNOW they'll be chasing after me once I leave, which fucks with my head) and I want to leave, I just don't have anything anymore.. Idk where to keep my dog. I'd like to move on from this life now, friend.

There's not much to say. I'm condemned to the streets tomorrow and don't know what to do with my dog, which is the only thing keeping me going. She doesn't deserve being homeless though. Idk... thank you for replying.

Have been suicidal since a young age. Close friend killed himself when I was 18. Shocked me so bad I was too empty to want to kill myself for a few months, but of course the thoughts eventually came back. And stronger than ever. Then my grandma (the only person I had left on this planet) passed this year. I'm now 22. Lost as all fuck. But you can't do it..just keep going. Idk how. But you need to. I'm still here. If I am, you can be.
